_comment: Portraits for the Science DB People entries (SCIDB.PROFILES in ee/ragtag/world/sciencedb.lua).
Each prompt is: prefix + style + 'Subject: ' + look. Keep `style` the same for every face so the set
matches; change one character's `look` to redo just that one: python3 tools/make_portraits.py --who quill.
The looks are the canon for how these people appear: keep the profiles and arc text consistent with them.
prefix: Use this prompt as written; do not add characters, objects, text or scenery.
style: Square 1:1 painted digital portrait in the style of gritty, lived-in frontier science fiction concept art. Head and shoulders only, one person, centred, body turned slightly, eyes looking at the viewer; the face fills the middle third of the frame with the same amount of space above the head in every image. Plain dark slate-grey background with a faint teal rim light on the right edge, nothing else behind them. Soft key light from the upper left. Muted, desaturated palette; visible brushwork, realistic proportions, not a cartoon, not a photograph. Worn, practical clothing of a spacefaring frontier. No text, no letters, no logos, no insignia with words, no border, no frame, no watermark, no signature.

characters.name: Thresh
characters.look: a lean man in his late fifties, fixer for a salvage yard. Narrow weathered face, close-cropped grey hair, deep-set watchful grey eyes, a thin unreadable mouth that is almost a smile. Long dark canvas coat with the collar turned up over a grey knit sweater, a small earpiece in one ear. Dry, discreet, patient: someone who listens more than he talks.

characters.name: Orlan Rezkov
characters.look: a heavyset man in his early sixties who runs a smuggling network. Shaved head, short iron-grey beard, heavy brows over pale, unblinking eyes that seem to be memorising the viewer. A deep-purple high-collared coat of good but old cloth, a heavy ring on one hand resting at his chin. Calm, powerful, quietly dangerous.

characters.name: Reva Okonkwo
characters.look: a Black woman of about fifty, former warship gunnery chief and now the leader of a pirate haven. Close-cropped greying natural hair, a pale scar along the left side of her jaw, steady dark eyes, unsmiling. Battered olive military jacket with its rank badges torn off, the stitching marks still visible, a sidearm strap over one shoulder. Blunt, fair, hard to impress.

characters.name: Commander Kael
characters.look: a woman of about fifty, a commander in a government intelligence service and a former fighter pilot. Dark hair with grey streaks pulled back tightly, sharp cheekbones, composed and precise expression, eyes that miss nothing. Crisp charcoal-grey officer's uniform with a high collar and small plain silver rank pips, immaculate. Patient, controlled, does not bluff.

characters.name: Dr. Mara Quill
characters.look: a woman in her mid-forties, a research scientist who escaped a disaster. Auburn hair pinned up loosely with strands falling free, pale freckled skin, dark shadows under intense green eyes, tight-lipped determination. A stained off-white lab coat over grey thermal layers, a faded blank shoulder patch where an institute badge was removed. Exhausted, stubborn, relentless.

characters.name: Dr. Nell Varga
characters.look: a woman of about sixty, the only doctor at a remote farming depot. Short practical silver hair, warm brown skin, kind tired eyes with deep laugh lines, reading glasses pushed up on her head. Faded blue clinic scrubs under a padded quilted vest, a stethoscope around her neck. Tired, direct and kind.

characters.name: Ines Calloway
characters.look: a woman in her early fifties, foreman of an asteroid mining camp. Weathered tanned skin, a small old burn scar on one cheekbone, thick dark hair streaked with grey in a heavy braid over one shoulder, scratched safety goggles pushed up on her forehead. Heavy rust-orange mining coverall, grimy, with a hi-vis stripe. Gruff, unafraid, a hint of dry humour.

characters.name: Anton Marchetti
characters.look: a man of about thirty, chief engineer of a shipyard, young for the job and a bit of a nerd. Olive skin, unruly dark curly hair, a few days of stubble, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a grease smudge on one cheekbone, a quick lopsided grin and bright, curious eyes. Worn dark-blue work jacket with tool loops and a rolled-up sleeve, styluses and a small screwdriver in the chest pocket, a pair of magnifier goggles hanging around his neck. Fast-talking, warm, endlessly tinkering, a little reckless.

characters.name: Sione Taufa
characters.look: a huge, broad-shouldered Tongan man in his late fifties who runs an unlicensed fighting ring. Warm brown skin, a broad weathered face, a close-trimmed grey beard, thick salt-and-pepper hair tied back, a flattened boxer's nose and a scar through one eyebrow; small dark eyes that are sizing the viewer up, a slow half-smile showing one gold tooth. A heavy dark-red longcoat over a worn grey shirt, a thick gold chain, scarred knuckles resting on a battered data-slate of odds. A former dockyard prize fighter: friendly, unhurried, and not someone to cross.
